instruction_model.checks: Exact clock count, bit order, raw parity, read aperture ordering, unrelated GPIO preservation, high exit and ABI; ideal inputs only, not electrical latency.

note: Private cmd.swd_window=0..3 plus cmd.set_swd_clock(20000000) selects laboratory reader; this command value is not a measurement or certification of the candidate clock. cmd.swd_full=0 retains legacy header/ACK/write; 1 accelerates header and write; 2 also accelerates ACK. Turnarounds remain conservative.
